name: RES (second-order exponential step)
plain: A two-stage exponential integrator in log-sigma time: one extra model call at the midpoint, with phi-function weights for the two clean-image guesses. It is the same family as RES4LYF's res_2s, in Clybius's version.
math:
Symbols: λ = −ln σ; h = λ' − λ; c₂ = 0.5.
x₂ = e^(−c₂h)·x + a₂₁·h·D; D₂ = model(x₂, σ₂), σ₂ = e^(−(λ + c₂h)).
x' = e^(−h)·x + h·(b₁·D + b₂·D₂), with a₂₁, b₁, b₂ from φ₁, φ₂.
